page.layout: One column of text, top to bottom; no margin notes. Running head at top with page number left and chapter/verse heading right.

p.i: tas hac tria : maior autem his charitas:

main_text.p: Hactenus de necessitate & praestantiâ Charitatis: eius natura, vel ingenium sequitur ab omnibus pravis affectibus longissimè abhorrens.
4 Charitas longanimis est, benigna est, charitas non amulatur, charitas non agit perperam, non inflatur.
5 Non indecorè agit non quaerit sua, non irritatur, non cogitat malum.
9 Non gaudet de iniustitiâ, congaudet autem veritati.
7 Omnia suffert, omnia credit, omnia sperat, omnia sustinet.

page.notes: Running head and page number as printed; the "Verf." at right is a catchword-like marker set after the text, kept as a paragraph. Some long-s and ligature forms (s, st, ct) normalised to modern letters. Lower half of the page is blank. Scan shows show-through of the reverse page at the right edge, omitted.
